# Vintage

> Proof of age for private money. Vintage proves that every shielded Ironwood coin a Zcash transaction spends
> already existed before a chosen block: a hack inflow, a tax cutoff, a bug window, or any height you name.
> The proof is the transaction's anchor, which Zcash consensus checks on every spend. Anyone can verify it
> from the txid and public chain data. No keys, amounts, senders or history are revealed.

Built for ZECATHON 2026 (Core & Tooling). Open source, MIT OR Apache-2.0. Live on Zcash mainnet.

## Pages

- [Home](https://usevintage.site/): the claim, live mainnet evidence, limits
- [How it works](https://usevintage.site/how-it-works/): the problem, the anchor mechanism, exchange integration with the API, fresh coins, limits, FAQ
- [Events](https://usevintage.site/events/): what an event is, the signed registry, event types
- [Privacy](https://usevintage.site/privacy/): what each party sees, what the service keeps (anonymous daily counts only)
- [Simulate](https://usevintage.site/simulate/): step-by-step exchange deposit, NEAR Intents swap, fresh coins and tainted coins, with live checks
- [Verifier](https://app.usevintage.site/): paste a txid, pick an event, get a verdict

## API

- `GET https://api.usevintage.site/verify/{txid}?before={event-id|height}`: verdict (PASS, FAIL, NOT_PROVABLE) and evidence
- `POST https://api.usevintage.site/verify-link`: receipt-account link check for coins received after an event
- `GET https://api.usevintage.site/events`: the signed event registry
- `GET https://api.usevintage.site/stats`: anonymous daily counts
- `GET https://api.usevintage.site/health`: network and chain tip

## Mainnet evidence

- PASS: deposit `da9017e0fca0d8bd87def8e3faa7956067f2bd2234cfee91ca7ad4e67095e3a7`, anchored at block 3,525,696, before event block 3,525,709 (a staged demo event)
- LINK PASS: deposit `df151ee2e670d683018edd85bb1bf8eca2ccefe3ff464853368c1ff949db9402`, funded by the PASS transaction
- FAIL: `a4c7622f2e3e39ce0cd5a65fc4417f490568990a6f90fda5579a924a0d83c143`, which spends coins received after the event
